obligation: G103 -- NR container spec with no machine-specific fields

negative_test_detail.note: the validator caught the injection three separate ways -- two deny-listed field names and the structural rule that a kernel_requirements entry may name a REQUIREMENT but never an IMPLEMENTATION

the_subtle_case_the_spec_had_to_get_righ: The obligation lists 'kernel requirements' as an NR field, which sounds machine-specific and is not. NR may say 'this stream needs a grouped-absmax decoder at group 64' because that is a property of the REPRESENTATION. It may not say 'dispatch qwen_uniform_q4_group64_matvec_geo_tpr64_tg128 at threadgroup 128' because that is a property of a MACHINE. Requirement is portable, binding is not, and the validator enforces the line structurally rather than by name-matching alone.
empty_sections_are_measured_not_unfilled: entropy_streams, shared_structures, generated_structures, latent_codes, correction_planes, exact_islands and route_graph are all EMPTY in the serialized candidate, and the container says why inline: G035 and G062 refuted sharing, G042 records GENERATED_BPW_EQUIVALENT and CORRECTION_BPW at 0, G043 records ROUTING_FLOPS at 0 for this dense model, and no packer emits an entropy stream. An empty section that does not say whether it is refuted or merely unbuilt is the same defect as a missing axis, which G041 already recorded for the T axis.
